basis: Predeclared independent cases. The expected pitch is the authored fixture engraving interval, 10 µm. Recover its spacing from the rendered image intensities. At nominal 2.4 µm sensor pitch and 0.63× relay, the two physical sampling tolerances are one object-space pixel each. No physical camera acquisition or optical bench measurement is claimed.

tests.test: Resolve adjacent engraved marks at 10× from rendered pixels.
Resolve the same marks at 20× from rendered pixels.
Double objective magnification; the spacing in camera pixels doubles.
At 20×, span of 52.5 pixels between interpolated endpoint positions.
Select fluorescence on the transmitted-light Ts2 stand.
With Ts2-FL configured for blue excitation and green emission, acquire the labeled morphology and find nonzero green contrast.
Move the 20× synthetic micrometer from best focus to 10 µm defocus; the peak-to-trough contrast must decrease.
Disable the epi module on the Ts2-FL stand and request fluorescence.
Image a field containing only the longer fifth-division marks; no minor-division pitch may be reported.
At zero synthetic illumination and fixed exposure, the stage micrometer has zero red/green/blue signal and no pitch reading.
Halving excitation at fixed exposure halves the green-channel peak for the unsaturated fluorescent morphology, within 8-bit rounding.

experimentalComparison: Independent measured microscope images with known camera calibration and focus offsets were unavailable. The acceptance experiment uses a generated metrology fixture.
